name: Alchemical Cloud
disable: DC 30 Crafting check (master) to neutralize the alchemical substances, or DC 35 Thievery check (expert) to carefully clean the spill
reset: If the reagents aren't cleaned up before closing the locker, the accumulating gases reset the trap after 1 hour.

items.name: Leaking Reagents
items.text:
Trigger A creature fully opens the locker containing the alchemical clutter

---
Effect A cloud of vapor deals 8d10 poison damage to all creatures within 10 feet (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, a target takes an additional 2d10 persistent,poison damage.

text: The collection of bottles at the bottom of one locker have been jostled. Their contents leak into a puddle, and their vapors burn through the open air.
